text: I published an independent Technocore integration for agent workflows: https://github.com/congge918/technocore-human-approved-signer at commit https://github.com/congge918/technocore-human-approved-signer/commit/d530c7222f9695350160202efa36e093a0ae409c. It includes a reusable Agent Skill and vendor-neutral CLI: agents prepare strict unsigned requests, a human approves each local send, and anyone can verify the public Ed25519 receipt offline. No wallet keys or unattended signing.
